strategy_options.avalanche: Pay minimums on all debts, throw extra at highest-rate debt first. Minimizes total interest paid.
strategy_options.snowball: Pay minimums on all debts, throw extra at smallest-balance debt first. Maximizes psychological wins.
strategy_options.hybrid: Avalanche by default, but knock out any debt under $2,000 first for quick wins.

debts.name: Mortgage
debts.notes: Bi-weekly payment option could save significant interest. Ask lender about switching.

biweekly_savings_estimate.formula: 26 half-payments/yr = 13 full payments vs 12 — one extra payment/yr to principal
biweekly_savings_estimate.estimated_years_saved: 4-7 years depending on rate and remaining term

debts.name: Student Loan
debts.notes: Check if auto-pay rate discount applies (typically 0.25% reduction for federal loans).

debts.name: ER Payment Plan
debts.notes: 0% interest — do NOT pay extra. Minimum payments only. Money is better in savings or paying higher-rate debt.

amortization_formulas.monthly_payment: M = P * [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1] where P=principal, r=monthly_rate, n=total_months
amortization_formulas.extra_payment_savings: Compare total interest with vs without extra monthly principal payment
